minimal.description: Bare minimum: the stack-agnostic core rules plus skill-lifecycle governance. No orchestration/review/quality skills, no stack components.

core.description: Today's curated subset made explicit: common rules plus orchestration, quality, and generic review skill modules. No stack-specific components.

ts-js-node.description: Common rules plus the TypeScript/JavaScript (Node.js) stack pack component (`ts-js-node-rules` + `ts-js-node-skills`, from src/gdskills/bundled/stacks/ts-js-node/), installed when `keryx stack detect` finds a matching tag.

react.description: Common rules plus the React/MobX-aware review component set, installed when `keryx stack detect` finds a matching tag (fail open when detection is unavailable or uncertain).

go.description: Common rules plus the Go stack pack component (`go-rules` + `go-skills`, from src/gdskills/bundled/stacks/go/), installed when `keryx stack detect` finds a matching tag.

nestjs.description: Common rules plus the NestJS-aware review component set, installed when `keryx stack detect` finds a matching tag (fail open when detection is unavailable or uncertain).

vue.description: Common rules plus the Vue stack pack component (`vue-rules` + `vue-skills`, from src/gdskills/bundled/stacks/vue/), installed when `keryx stack detect` finds a matching tag.

django.description: Common rules plus the Django-aware component set (extends `python`), installed when `keryx stack detect` finds a matching tag (fail open when detection is unavailable or uncertain).

docker-k8s-terraform.description: Common rules plus the Docker/Kubernetes/Terraform tool pack component, installed when `keryx stack detect` finds a matching tag (docker, docker-compose, or terraform). Experimental: has not cleared the honest behavioral eval gate yet.

full.description: Every registered module and component, unconditionally.

review-core-skills.description: Generic (non-stack-specific) review skills: orchestrator, logic, architecture, security, performance, clean-code, highload, regression, core-boundaries, flow-graph, layout, style, testing-practices, verifier, pr-feedback, and the legacy AI/learned/style review profiles.
